title: --scope user with no harness user folder is nothing to do (exit 0), leaves an old block in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md in place, and --remove still takes it out
source: intended: owner decision (v0.2): JITSO writes instruction blocks to AGENTS.md files only, never to CLAUDE.md
intent: INTENDED behavior (setup instructions writes AGENTS.md only). An empty home has none of `~/.codex`, `~/.config/opencode` and `~/.pi/agent`, so there is no user `AGENTS.md` to write: the command prints `jitso setup instructions: nothing to do (no harness user folder found: ~/.codex, ~/.config/opencode, ~/.pi/agent)`, exit 0, and creates nothing (no `~/.claude`). A block an older jitso left in `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` is never taken out by an add (it is the block Claude Code reads); `--remove --yes` still removes it byte-exactly.

stdout.equals: jitso setup instructions: nothing to do (no harness user folder found: ~/.codex, ~/.config/opencode, ~/.pi/agent)
jitso setup instructions: nothing to do (no harness user folder found: ~/.codex, ~/.config/opencode, ~/.pi/agent)
